text: Hastinapur (Hastināpur) is a city in the Meerut district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. In Jain tradition, Hastinapur is associated with the births of three of the 24 Tirthankaras: Shantinatha, Kunthunatha, Aranatha. It is also traditionally associates with the place where the first Tirthankara, Rishabhanatha, broke his fast of approximately 400 days by accepting sugarcane juice offered by Raja Shreyansa Kumar, an event commemorated by Jains on Akshaya Tritiya. It is described as the capital of the Kuru kingdom in Hindu texts such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas; Hastinapur is located on the right bank of the Ganga river.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
